title: OneMind built-in app descriptor (the built-in profile of the onemind.app/v1 App manifest)
description: What one built-in (system) app plugs into: search, share, notifications, map layers, cards, agent actions, settings, backup, data classes and the phone. Lives at core/onemind_core/<id>/onemind.app.yaml and is read only for ids on the signed system apps list (/usr/lib/onemind/system-apps.json). It is the same manifest as a Market app (apiVersion onemind.app/v1, kind App, one file name) in its built-in profile: metadata carries only id, name and description because a built-in ships inside the OS image (no version, licence, source or tier of its own), and no spec block reuses a name onemind.app.schema.json gives another shape. spec.backup is the App spec.backup block (its units field), and search, share, notifications, mapLayers and data are App spec blocks too since manifest v1 (#604); routes, cards, actions, settingsPages and phone are descriptor-only. test_builtin_conformance.py fails if a descriptor block stops validating against the App schema block of the same name. The conformance test core/tests/test_builtin_conformance.py checks every descriptor against the running gateway.

id.description: The id on the signed list; must equal the folder name.

prefix.description: A public API path prefix such as /v1/photos: the path itself and everything under it.

call.description: One public API operation, METHOD and OpenAPI path template, e.g. GET /v1/files/list. It must exist in sdk/openapi/onemind-v1.json (rule 12: a built-in uses only the public door).

owns.description: Prefixes that belong to this app. While the app is switched off every request under them answers 409 stale_precondition, reason app_disabled (one gateway gate, builtins.py). Two built-ins never own overlapping prefixes.

search.description: The app's search provider: the item types it adds to the one local index.

items.description: A topic routes catalogue events (events: system topic of that id, notify/catalogue.py), or is one the app posts itself through its app principal (title: shown on Settings > Notifications), or both. Whatever the app posts lands under app.<metadata.id>.<id> (notify/topics.py), at most 80 characters, severity info or warning.

id.description: The notification topic (notify/catalogue.py), e.g. backups; app posts use app.<app id>.<id>.

title.description: What the topic is called in Settings > Notifications, e.g. Reminders.

action.description: An action type the gateway has registered (a FeatureAction). mcp: true makes it a request-only MCP tool; an agent can only file the request and a person approves it.

settingsPage.description: A Settings page the host draws from one public read operation. Not the App spec.settings field list (owner-editable env values of a container app).

backupUnit.description: Same as onemind.app.schema.json $defs/backupUnit (a test keeps the two equal). table: a gateway database table. dir: the folder a gateway setting (ONEMIND_*) names.

backup.description: The App spec.backup block with its units field required. An empty list requires an explicit reason.
